items.quote: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth
items.claim: Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth

items.quote: Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city
items.claim: Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth and those at the gate of his city
items.place: in the audience of the children of Heth, at the gate of his city

items.quote: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee
items.claim: Ephron gives his field and cave to Abraham

items.quote: in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee
items.claim: Ephron gives the property in the presence of his people
items.mechanism: in the presence of the sons of my people

items.claim: Abraham is instructed to bury his dead
